subject: File names with non-ascii characters breaks the deploy process

messages.author: 75948aab8211de84
messages.subject: File names with non-ascii characters breaks the deploy process
parts:
Hi,

When I deploy an app to shinyapps.io, I got the following error:

Waiting for task: 404958
  building: Parsing manifest
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 404959 error: Unhandled Exception: 'ascii' codec can't encode characters in position 79-81: ordinal not in range(128)
Execution halted

It seems that a file with Chinese file name broke something, might be a bug.

​
